items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with a very good pianist in Zack Whyte's band, too.

ctx.x: -- you see? Because that was his friend.
Now, he, to me, -- after you talk about Art Tatum, it's hard to talk about other pianists. I worked with a very good pianist in Zack Whyte's band, too. His name was Herman Chittison Chitizen.
